use = [0] * 17
for i in range(1, 17):
    use[i] = use[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def recursive_solve(n, d):
    sum_value = (n // use[d]) * d
    n %= use[d]
    if n == 0:
        return sum_value
    candidate1 = recursive_solve(use[d] - n, d - 1) + d
    candidate2 = recursive_solve(n, d - 1)
    return sum_value + min(candidate1, candidate2)

val = int(input())
print(recursive_solve(val, 16))
